wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 06-004 pins the public-surface contract of the masked-midtexture and two-sided-wall rendering primitives (renderMaskedSegRange, renderTwoSidedWall) and the MAXSHORT=0x7fff done-flag sentinel. The read-only src/render/maskedTextures.ts and src/render/twoSidedWalls.ts modules already implement the canonical R_RenderMaskedSegRange + R_RenderSegLoop two-sided pass; this step's focused test asserts the surface (function existence, arity, exported types, sentinel value, comment anchors) so later render-lane steps cannot accidentally regress the pre-pinned semantics. No source file is modified.
